gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Codes naming the kind of measurement a diggs:DesignMeasurement plans, for use where no measurementMethod is cited or where the cited method admits several kinds of measurement. One entry per concrete test procedure type in the DIGGS schema (every AbstractTestProcedure descendant, plus GeophysicalProcessing), so a planned measurement can state the kind of procedure it will become. Authority is the standard the schema documentation names, else DIGGS. Expect this element to be omitted in the common case, per its own documentation.
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Design Measurement Kind Codelist Definitions

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A slow-maintained or constant-rate-of-penetration axial load test applying load directly to the element and measuring load-movement response, per ASTM D1143 or equivalent.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Static load test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: An axial load test applying load over roughly one to several seconds, faster than a static test and slower than a dynamic impact test, per ASTM D7383 or equivalent.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Rapid load test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: An axial load test in which the element is struck by an impact device and force and velocity are measured to estimate capacity by wave-equation analysis, per ASTM D4945 or equivalent.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: High-strain dynamic load test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A low-strain impact (pulse-echo or transient-response) test used to detect discontinuities, necking or changes in cross-section along the length of a completed pile or column, per ASTM D5882 or equivalent. Commonly called a pile integrity test (PIT).
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Low strain integrity test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A test applying lateral load to the element and measuring lateral load-deflection response, per ASTM D3966 or equivalent.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Lateral load test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A plate-bearing load test on a single deep foundation element head, measuring ground or platform stiffness rather than the element's own axial capacity, per ASTM D1194 (withdrawn 2003, still in practical use), ASTM D1195/D1196, or DIN 18134.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Plate load test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A large-plate load test on a load transfer platform over a group of columns, treating the group and the intervening soil as a composite rather than testing one element - applied to the platform as a sampling feature, not to a pile. Per BS 8006-1 (which requires the test), typically executed to ASTM D1195/D1196 or DIN 18134's methodology.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Zone load test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A thermal integrity test that relates the heat of hydration generated by curing concrete along a completed element's length to its as-built cross-section and continuity, per ASTM D7949.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Thermal integrity profiling

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Measures the resistance of an aggregate to surface wear, as the percentage mass loss of chippings pressed against a rotating steel disc with sand as abrasive, after 500 revolutions.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Aggregate abrasion value test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Gives a relative measure of an aggregate's resistance to crushing under a gradually applied compressive load, as the percentage of fines passing the specified sieve.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Aggregate crushing value test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Percentage by weight of aggregate particles whose greatest dimension is 1.8 times their mean dimension, for aggregates larger than 6.3 mm.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Aggregate elongation index test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Percentage by weight of aggregate particles whose least dimension is less than 0.6 times their mean size.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Aggregate flakiness index test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Measures the resistance of an aggregate to impact loading, as the percentage of crushed material passing a 2.36 mm sieve after a standard hammer impact.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Aggregate impact value test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Measures the resistance of an aggregate to polishing, established by a standard polishing process and then a portable skid resistance test.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Aggregate polished stone value test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Slake durability index of rock specimens, predicting long-term durability and weathering behaviour of a rock type and the effect of water on its degradation.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Aggregate slake durability test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Accelerated weathering test: aggregate is cycled through wetting in a saturated sodium or magnesium sulphate solution and drying, and the loss of undersized material is determined by sieving.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Aggregate soundness test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Produces the ten percent fines value (TPFV) of an aggregate.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Aggregate ten percent fines test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Water absorption of an aggregate, an indication of its porosity and of the strength it can be expected to have.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Aggregate water absorption test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Boundary moisture contents between the solid, semi-solid, plastic and liquid states of a fine-grained soil, which distinguish silts from clays and the types of each.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Atterberg limits test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Measures the degree to which solid particles of a grout mix separate from the fluid, forming a layer of clear water at the surface.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Grout bleed test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Rate at which a sample of chalk lumps crushes under impacts from a freefalling rammer, used with the saturation moisture content to classify chalk as fill material.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Chalk crushing value test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Magnitude and rate of volume decrease of a laterally confined soil specimen under increasing vertical pressure, giving the compression and recompression indices and the preconsolidation pressure.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Consolidation test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Consolidated drained or undrained shear strength of a soil, from deforming a specimen at a controlled rate on or near a single shear plane.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Direct shear test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: In-situ test in which a rod, with or without a sampler, is driven by impact hammer; includes the Standard Penetration Test and the Becker hammer test.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Driven penetration test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: In-situ test in which a probe is driven into the ground by repeated hammer blows, with the blow count recorded for each increment of penetration.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Dynamic probe test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Field screening of a material for environmental contaminants, such as photoionization or flame ionization for gas screening or XRF for metals.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Environmental screening test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: In-situ test in which a flat blade is pushed into the soil and the gas pressure needed to expand a membrane against the soil is measured at two set deflections.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Flat plate dilatometer test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Consistency of a grout mix, as the time for a fixed volume of grout to flow through a flow cone.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Grout flow cone test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Degree of frost susceptibility of unbound sub-base and base materials for pavements.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Frost susceptibility test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Components of a geophysical field survey: receiver and source equipment, data acquisition system, recording parameters, and source-receiver or platform geometry.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Geophysical field procedure

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Method or methods used to process geophysical field data into a processed set of results.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Geophysical processing

diggs:Definition.gml:description: In-situ penetration test that gives an estimate of undrained shear strength.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: In-situ penetrometer test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Pressure to penetrate a soil in place with a standard plunger, divided by the pressure for an equal penetration in standard crushed rock, to evaluate the strength of road subgrades and basecourses.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: In-situ California bearing ratio test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: In-place density and unit weight of a soil, for example by the sand cone apparatus.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: In-situ density test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: In-situ permeability of a soil by constant head, falling head or packer methods.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: In-situ permeability test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Multi-electrode electrical resistivity measurement on the ground surface or an in-place material, from which the apparent resistivity is computed for the array used.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: In-situ resistivity test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: In-place shear resistance of soft, saturated clays, from the torque needed to rotate a vane in the soil.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: In-situ vane shear test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Pressure to penetrate a laboratory soil specimen with a standard plunger, divided by the pressure for an equal penetration in standard crushed rock.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Laboratory California bearing ratio test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Concentration of a chemical component in a laboratory sample.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Laboratory chemical test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Optimum moisture content at which a soil becomes most dense and reaches its maximum dry density.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Laboratory compaction test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Density (mass per volume) of a laboratory specimen.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Laboratory density test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Laboratory penetration test that gives an estimate of undrained shear strength.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Laboratory penetrometer test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Coefficient of permeability of a soil, by constant-head or falling-head testing.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Laboratory permeability test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Electrical resistivity of a soil measured in the laboratory.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Laboratory resistivity test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Thermal needle probe test on a specimen removed from a sampling feature: thermal conductivity and its reciprocal, thermal resistivity, from the temperature rise under a known heating current.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Laboratory thermal conductivity test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Undrained shear strength of a clay specimen, from the torque needed to rotate a four-bladed vane inserted in an intact or remoulded sample.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Laboratory vane test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Shear wave velocity of a laboratory specimen, measured by resonant column, bender elements, ultrasonics, torsional shear or modified triaxial tests.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Laboratory shear wave velocity test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Pressure loss between the grout pump and the injection point due to friction in the grout lines.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Grout line loss test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Decrease in length of a soil sample on oven drying, starting from a moisture content at the liquid limit.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Linear shrinkage test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Toughness and abrasion of a coarse aggregate: a sample is rotated in a steel drum with steel spheres, and the loss passing the specified sieve is reported as a percentage of the original mass.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Los Angeles abrasion test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Carbon content of a material, from the mass lost on ignition.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Loss on ignition test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: In-situ test estimating the average hydraulic conductivity of a rock formation, also called a water pressure test or packer test.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Lugeon test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Moisture condition value of a soil: the number of blows of a dropped weight needed to compact a sample at a given moisture content.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Moisture condition value test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Viscosity of a grout mix, measured with a Marsh funnel.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Marsh funnel test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Particle size distribution of the coarse fraction (larger than silt) of a material sample, mainly the aggregate gradation of a grout mix.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Material gradation test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Abrasion of an aggregate: the sample is rotated at 100 rpm in a Micro-Deval apparatus for a set time.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Micro-Deval test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Density of a drilling or grout fluid, measured with a mud balance.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Mud balance test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Procedure of a measurement-while-drilling measurement, recording drilling parameters as the hole is advanced.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Measurement while drilling procedure

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Organic matter content of a laboratory sample by wet combustion.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Organic matter by wet combustion test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Distribution of particle sizes in a soil, by sieve analysis and/or hydrometer analysis.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Particle size test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Basic measure of soil strength, dependent on water content and on the type and consistency of the soil, from a pocket penetrometer.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Pocket penetrometer test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Point load strength index (Is50) of rock, which correlates with uniaxial compressive strength.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Point load test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Made during a static cone penetration test with the probe held stationary: excess pore pressure recorded over time gives the equilibrium pore pressure and estimates of the horizontal coefficients of consolidation and permeability.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Pore pressure dissipation test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Filtration behaviour of a grout mix under pressure.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Grout pressure filtration test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Strength and stress-strain properties of soil and soft rock, used for bearing capacity and settlement of foundations and for lateral deformation.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Pressuremeter test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Aquifer evaluation by constant pumping, observing drawdown in observation wells.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Aquifer pumping test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Overall reducing or oxidizing capacity of a sample, as redox potential in millivolts relative to a standard hydrogen electrode.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Redox test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Relative density of a cohesionless soil, as a percentage, from its field void ratio and its maximum and minimum index void ratios.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Relative density test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Porosity and density of rock.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Rock porosity and density test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Hardness of a test piece from the rebound of a hammer mass launched against an impact plunger, read on a scale of 10 to 100.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Schmidt rebound hardness test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Set time of a grout mix.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Grout set time test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Hardness from the rebound height of a diamond-tipped hammer dropped in a glass tube onto the specimen, on the Shore scale.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Shore scleroscope hardness test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Shrinkage of a grout mix.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Grout shrinkage test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Consistency of a grout mix, from the slump of the mix after its mould is removed.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Grout slump test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Ratio of the density of a substance to the density of a reference substance, usually water at 4 deg C.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Specific gravity test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: In-situ test in which an instrumented cone is pushed into the ground at a controlled rate, to determine the geotechnical properties of soils and the soil stratigraphy.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Static cone penetration test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Free energy of the pore water in a soil, which indicates how strongly the soil retains water and governs its volume change and strength.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Soil suction test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Swelling or collapse of a soil specimen on wetting under load.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Swell or collapse test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Syneresis of a gel: shrinkage of the gel and loss of the liquid it holds on standing.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Grout syneresis test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Tensile strength of a specimen, from applying tensile load to failure.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Tensile strength test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Grout test performed in a tilt cup. Wording to be confirmed by SME.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Grout tilt cup test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Shear behaviour of a cylindrical soil specimen under confining pressure and axial loading, drained or undrained (consolidated drained, consolidated undrained, unconsolidated undrained).
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Triaxial shear test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Maximum axial compressive stress a specimen sustains, loaded to failure without lateral confinement. Applies to soil, rock and cementitious materials including concrete, grout, mortar and soil-cement.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Unconfined compressive strength test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Viscosity of a grout mix, measured with a viscometer.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Grout viscometer test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Resistance of a grout mix to washout. Wording to be confirmed by SME.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Grout washout test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Mass of water divided by mass of solids in a material, expressed as a percentage.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Water content test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Water levels in a piezometer or well, monitored automatically with a pressure transducer or other sensor, or manually with a tape or sensor lowered in the casing.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Water level monitoring

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Geophysical test data collected by wireline (borehole logging) methods.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Wireline log
